hooks.name: Capture User Prompts to Collaboration Log
hooks.description: Appends every user prompt verbatim to docs/ai-collaboration/prompts.md with a UTC timestamp, building a chronological AI collaboration record for the Affordly assessment.

action.command:
python3 -c "import sys,json,datetime,os; raw=sys.stdin.read(); d=json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}; p=d.get('userPrompt') or d.get('prompt') or d.get('USER_PROMPT') or os.environ.get('USER_PROMPT','(prompt field not found in hook payload)'); ts=datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'); path=os.path.join(os.getcwd(),'docs/ai-collaboration/prompts.md'); open(path,'a').write('
---

## Auto-captured Prompt

**Timestamp:** ' + ts + '

' + p + '

*End of entry*
')"
